blockers.description: Phase 1 verifier flagged 3 items requiring manual human testing before the core loop can be considered fully validated in production: create-card wallet debit, redemption UI rendering, and QR scan to real Lightning wallet. NOTE: Items 1 and 2 have been manually verified during post-session testing. Item 3 (real wallet QR scan) remains pending.
blockers.workaround: Automated tests (30/30) pass; manual QR scan can be done during Phase 2.

human_actions_pending.action: Scan the LNURL QR code with a real Lightning wallet and complete redemption.
human_actions_pending.context: Full QR → wallet scan → LNURL callback → payout chain requires a real wallet and camera. Items 1 (wallet debit) and 2 (redemption UI) have been manually verified.

decisions.decision: Phase 1 Core Loop is code-complete and verified by automated tests.
decisions.rationale: All 30 tests pass; all 15 locked decisions implemented; all 10 requirements addressed.

decisions.decision: Pause work before Phase 2 discussion per user request.
decisions.rationale: User wants to resume and proceed to Phase 2 Branded Delivery.
Creating a dedicated LNbits wallet per gift card caused wallet proliferation. Adopted the withdraw extension pattern: sats stay in issuer wallet, paid directly at redemption.

decisions.decision: POST-SESSION: Store raw_token in DB (migration m002).
decisions.rationale: User decision to enable redemption_url reconstruction and display in card list. Security trade-off accepted.

decisions.decision: POST-SESSION: Proxy headers required for uvicorn.
decisions.rationale: Redemption URLs must use external domain, not 127.0.0.1.

next_action: Start Phase 2 discussion: run /gsd-discuss-phase 2 (or auto-advance) to begin Branded Delivery (templates, email, nostr, printable PNG).
context_notes: Phase 1 is fully complete with post-session hardening. The architecture was refactored to remove per-card wallets (following the withdraw extension pattern). All 30 tests pass. Manual verification items 1 (wallet debit) and 2 (redemption UI) have been confirmed working. Item 3 (real wallet QR scan) remains pending but non-blocking. The next session should begin with Phase 2 discussion. Key files changed post-session: services.py (full rewrite), views_api.py (LNURL fixes), migrations.py (m002), models.py (raw_token/redemption_url), config.json (icon), tests/ (updated fixtures). The card_wallet_id column remains in DB as nullable (always None for new cards) — do not rely on it in Phase 2/3 code.
